remarks: Location & opportunity! Sited on almost half an acre w/natural gas in highly sought-after, quiet, yet incredibly convenient Lower North Stamford neighborhood, this 4BR, 2.5BA spacious Split presents w/picturesque curb appeal framed by an expansive front yard & a beautiful, stone drive. Inside, its light-filled open layout & great flow provides all the space you need at a price point that ensures a sound investment as you apply your own personal style. Formal living room w/bay wndw & greenhouse nook. Dining area w/fireplace flanked by EIK & family room. Large, updated EIK, the heart of the home (a home in which an adored family lived, laughed & forever loved for almost 60 yrs), w/gas cooking, granite & ample cabinetry. Cozy family room beckons w/vltd clngs & windowed surround. French dr to sun porch w/panoramic vws of bckyrd, enjoy mornings meditating & evenings entertaining. A few steps up: grand MBR, a sweet surprise w/FBA (dbl-sinks & w-in shwr). A few steps down: office (or 4th BR) smartly set apart, pwdr room, W/D & grg. Discover 5 skylights, hrdwd flrs, pocket drs, plantation shutters, recessed lights, fresh paint, superb bsmnt storage, gas heat, new gas water heater & newer C/A. Garden area & plenty of greenspace. Just 1/2mi to Merritt, less than 1mi to Northeast, Nature Center & High Ridge Retail (Trader Joe's, Starbucks & so much more). Less than 2mi to arboretum, golf, tennis, library, schools, fitness & many other area amenities.
